parameters.name: X-Node-Capabilities
parameters.description: Comma-separated features. native-routing-v1 is required when singBox is configured.

configurationHash.description: Panel-issued configuration SHA-256 for application receipts. Prefer this value over the transport ETag, which proxies may weaken or remove.

X-Target-Statistics-Policy.description: Optional JSON target statistics lease for target-statistics-policy-v2 capable nodes; refreshed on 200 and 304 without changing the configuration ETag. If absent, use the policy endpoint.

409.description: CONFLICT: batch ID reused with a different payload

batchId.description: Optional for legacy clients. Required for durable deduplicated batches; retries reuse the ID and identical records.

post.description: With batchId, 202 acknowledges durable receipt. Billing and daily statistics are applied atomically once per node and batch. Different records under the same ID return 409. Without batchId the existing non-deduplicated accounting path remains.

Physical-server scoped IP reporting. A bearer report credential identifies one server, never a protocol node or an arbitrary domain. Only domains attached to that server receive address snapshots; entry and origin servers remain independent. Cloudflare credentials and panel server_token are not accepted. Each address must be public and allowed by the server family. Missing families retain independent freshness timestamps; reports never contact DNS providers or reset provider backoff.

get.description: Server-wide raw proxy byte quota. Null means unbound. Higher limits recover service after the next poll; zero means unlimited. V2Box retains local limits during panel outages. Shared quotas across processes are eventually synchronized.

403.description: Credential is not authorized for this node identity.

get.description: Default off. A successful enabled lease allows at most 120 seconds of bounded in-memory target collection. Legacy nodes ignore this optional resource.

post.description: Optional non-billing target aggregates. Disabled or stale policy returns accepted=false. Retry the same immutable batch ID. Data expires from cache within one hour. Uncompressed JSON body limit: 262144 bytes. Quota: 30 requests/minute per authenticated node, independent of source IP. Each counter summed over all records in a batch must not exceed 1000000000000000; rejection writes no partial rows.

403.description: Credential is not authorized for this node identity.

get.description: Static Linux sh entry point for pinned V2Box v1.0.13 installation, configuration-preserving upgrade and scoped enrollment into multiple independent backends. Existing nodes, certificates and IP reporting targets are retained.

post.description: Burn a 10-minute one-use grant and issue one scoped credential. New grants supersede old grants. Credential/administrator changes invalidate grants; issuance does not happen until redemption. Lost responses require a new grant. No query tokens.

apiKey.description: One-time secret. Never logged or listed.

networkReport.description: Optional scoped address-reporting setup. Cloudflare credentials are never returned.

deployment.description: Scoped deployment readiness workflow. Managed modes verify DNS and certificates; unmanaged mode waits for fresh node application acknowledgement without DNS activation. Token expires after 24 hours and is stored privately for resume.

networkReport.description: Optional scoped address-reporting setup. Cloudflare credentials are never returned.

oneOf.description: Network-only setup: no node credentials or certificate workflow. Generated by an administrator using networkOnly=true; does not restart or reinstall V2Box.

networkReport.description: Optional scoped address-reporting setup. Cloudflare credentials are never returned.

oneOf.description: One-use physical-server enrollment. No node key or node installation. Shared reporting credentials are reused across domains on the same server.

parameters.name: X-Deployment-Capabilities
parameters.description: Comma-separated bootstrap features. runtime-ready-v1 also requests fresh applied-receipt verification for nodes without managed DNS; older clients keep their existing response.

agentVersion.description: Running V2Box release version; omitted by older agents.

configuration.description: Optional application receipt for the configuration ETag SHA-256. Stale hashes are ignored. No raw error text.

certificateFingerprint.description: SHA-256 leaf certificate fingerprint after certificate verification and listener startup.

transitionId.description: Echo the candidate transition ID. Applied transitions require an explicit publication acknowledgement.

domainTransitionAccepted.description: Present for domain transition receipts. True only after publishing the verified domain or acknowledging the exact already-committed operation.

dns.description: sing-box 1.14.3 native fields; validated by the node. No filesystem credentials or auth_user overrides.

route.description: sing-box 1.14.3 native fields; validated by the node. No filesystem credentials or auth_user overrides.

items.description: sing-box 1.14.3 native fields; validated by the node. No filesystem credentials or auth_user overrides.

networkSettings.description: sing-box 1.14.3 native fields; validated by the node. No filesystem credentials or auth_user overrides.

encryptionSettings.description: sing-box 1.14.3 native fields; validated by the node. No filesystem credentials or auth_user overrides.

singBox.description: Resolved native sing-box configuration from the V2Box-only routing catalog. Selected native rules are merged in selection order; legacy routes cannot be mixed with native rules.

trafficBatchDedup.description: When true, the panel supports durable deduplicated traffic batches. Missing means unsupported.

domainTransition.description: Candidate domain; verify public DNS and the certificate before starting listeners and reporting applied. Failure retains the previous configuration.

batchId.description: Optional for legacy clients. Required for durable deduplicated batches; retries reuse the ID and identical records.

reportIntervalSeconds.description: Optional reporting cadence. Omitted on older panels means 60 seconds. Refresh policy independently at most every 60 seconds; leaseSeconds remains at most 120.
